steps.description: The steps, in the order they run.

action.description: What the step does, in words.

tool.description: The one tool the step calls, by name.

args_json.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object written as a string, like {"query": "$fill"}. One that depends on an earlier step's result is "$fill".

depends_on.description: The ids of the steps whose results this step uses; [] if none, which makes it independent.

expected_result.description: What the step returns when it worked.

status.description: pending in a new plan; the executor sets done or failed as each step runs.
